$schema_note: Each endpoint becomes a static JSON file at public/api/v1/supply/<path>.json, served by GitHub Pages. `queryId` is the Dune query that produces the number; it must also be listed in dune-refresh/queries.json so it gets refreshed daily (build.js enforces this). `column` is the column to read from that query's result row. `invariants` declares the relationships that must hold between the fetched values — build.js fails the build, and so skips the deploy, if any is violated.

endpoints.description: Circulating supply = total supply - staked TON - locked TON. This is the figure CoinGecko reads.
Total supply = 50,000,000 TON + block seigniorage - burned TON - unminted (reduced) seigniorage.
Upbit's convention: staked TON is counted as circulating, so only locked TON is excluded.

invariants.because: staked TON is excluded from `circulating` but counted as circulating by Upbit
locked TON is excluded from every circulating figure
